metrics.deviations_planned: Two new pairings only, so the joint (task, state) bootstrap resamples 2 tasks; the state-only bootstrap is reported beside it as descriptive. The ledger tree is dirty (other agents' uncommitted files, incl. serve_guided.py and backbone.py; their diffs do not touch mode ours or pi05_libero / pi0_libero).
metrics.mapping: Main states k = 4-63 (60), familiar layout of LIVING_ROOM_SCENE5.  Success matrices [task, state]; paired bootstrap B = 2000, numpy default_rng(0), tasks and states drawn jointly (tv_frozen.boot2 / boot1 / atlas_est, unchanged); CI = 2.5 / 97.5.  (a) F1 atlas per model, arm I: tv_frozen.atlas_est (pp_atlas's estimator, stage rule and bar) with NEW = N1, N2 and partners N1 = (K1 object, K2 target), N2 = (K2 object, K1 target); a group BREAKS iff E > .10 and CI lo > 0.  A model is TESTABLE iff its intact success on K1-K2 is >= .70.  SCENE-2 F1 verdict over pi0.5 and GR00T: REPLICATES iff the cross-chunk group breaks on both (both testable); PARTIAL iff it breaks on exactly one; NOT REPLICATED iff on neither testable model; NOT TESTABLE iff neither is testable.  pi0 gets the per-model verdict only.  C1: the reference planner's success on N1-N2 >= .80 -> C1 MET, else C1 UNMET.  (b) Front end: pi0.5 PRIMARY d = tvp - I on N1-N2: CONFIRMED iff d > .10 and lo > 0; REFUTED iff hi < .10; else UNRESOLVED (tv_fresh's rule).  GR00T PRIMARY d = tv - I on N1-N2: TV WINS iff lo > 0; else NO CLEAR DIFFERENCE (tv_g's rule).  pi0.5 SECONDARY tv - I: the pi0.5 primary's rule.  GUARD per arm on K1-K2: NO COST iff (arm - I) lo > -.10, else COST.  SCENE-2 FIX verdict: REPLICATES iff both primaries win (CONFIRMED, TV WINS); PARTIAL iff one; NOT REPLICATED iff neither.  Descriptive: per-task success; N - K (N1 vs K1, N2 vs K2, same states); grasp correctness on N (first moved object = the named mug); habit placements (the named mug ends On its trained plate instead of the named one); atlas excess per arm; stage shares; KC / NC success and per-atom completion under I; the reference per task; state-only bootstrap (tasks fixed) for every delta; detector diagnostics (tv_frozen.side_summary).

metrics.scene: LIBERO-10 LIVING_ROOM_SCENE5: white (porcelain) mug, yellow-and-white mug, red mug, left plate (plate_1), right plate (plate_2). The only scene among the 40 training tasks with two movable objects bound to two targets (one compound task: white -> left, yellow-white -> right). New pairings N1 white -> right, N2 yellow-white -> left. The type pairing mug -> plate is trained (also LIBERO-10 scene 6), so what is new is which plate.
metrics.seen: Written after a feasibility pass and smokes, all on smoke states k = 0-3 (results/flawed/s2/branches_smoke.json), outputs outside results/ (.claude_tmp/pp/s2_smoke, s2_check).  Jobs: 4704506 (build states / BDDLs, sc_seg check; its keypoint step failed: no h5py in the LIBERO venv, and the LIBERO-90 single-step raw demos are absent), 4704525 (keypoints from the LIBERO-10 compound's own raw demos), 4704509-4704512 (VLA smokes), 4704654 and 4704674 (reference re-runs).  sc_seg does NOT transfer: its classes have no mug and one plate; on agentview the white mug's pixels read background .77 / bowl .20, the yellow-white mug background .60 / wine bottle .36, the right plate background .98; so tv / tvp use SIMULATOR masks (privileged).  VLA smoke (4 states each): pi0.5 I: K1 4/4, K2 4/4 (but it first moves the white mug to the left plate, i.e. it runs the trained compound), N1 0/4, N2 0/4, KC 4/4, NC 0/4; in every N and NC episode the final scene is the TRAINED compound (white on left, yellow-white on right).  pi0.5 tv: K1 4/4, K2 4/4, N1 0/4, N2 0/4 (habit placements persist).  pi0.5 tvp: K1 4/4, K2 4/4 (now the named mug is grasped first), N1 0/4 (white mug grasped, ends on the left plate 3/4), N2 0/4 (yellow-white grasped, ends on the right plate 3/4).  GR00T I: K1 3/4, K2 2/4 (two GRASP other_object), N1 0/4 (HANDOFF), N2 0/4 (2 HANDOFF, 2 GRASP other_object).  GR00T tv: K1 4/4, K2 0/4 (all grasp the painted white mug), N1 0/4, N2 0/4 (all grasp the painted white mug).  pi0 I: K1 3/4, N1 0/4.  Detector onsets within 1-3 steps of the oracle Held on held episodes.  Reference planner: first version (fitted offsets, 40-step carry limit) K1 4/4, K2 2/4, N1 1/4, N2 1/4; then two changes, both before this row and both on smoke states only: the carry phase limit raised to 120 steps (CARRY_STEPS) and the release made object-centred (the hand goes where the held mug's centre lies over the plate's centre, from the live hand-minus-mug offset).  Final smoke: K1 4/4, K2 3/4, N1 3/4, N2 3/4 (misses: one grasp miss on state 3 for the yellow-white mug in K2 and N2, one drop during the long N1 carry).  Nothing in the VLA client, front end or read changed after the VLA smokes.  Earlier results known when written: SR 46-49 and the atlas tables in docs/ARCH_FAILURES.md.
